originals.citation: Dang, J., Liu, Y., Liu, X., & Mao, L. (2017). The ego could be depleted, providing initial exertion is depleting: A preregistered experiment of the ego depletion effect. Social Psychology, 48(4), 242-245.

quote: A recent preregistered experiment with the Stroop task as the depleting task and the antisaccade task as the outcome task found a medium-level effect size. In the current research, we conducted a preregistered multilab replication of that experiment.
notes: Online sources confirm the procedure was that reported by Dang, Liu, Liu, and Mao (2017). Not @dang2017 (meta-analysis) or @hagger2016 (earlier RRR).
